# ECCO
Date: 2026-09-22 | Duration: 11.850000381469727m

## Summary
Witold was on the Starter plan, which limited visual editor access, so the organization was temporarily upgraded to Enterprise. A license seat limit was noted, and the visual editor became available after a refresh. The setup also contained duplicate GTM tags: a manual tag and a standard tag. The recommendation was to delete one to avoid conflicts. The scripts in use included Custom HTML and Grub Book Twitter flags scripts, and Witold was asked to stop the Custom HTML script for testing. Witold requested a video and documentation focused on setting up the first AA test. Logan encouraged further questions, and support from Remy and Natasha was acknowledged.

## Keywords
visual editor, enterprise tier, AI settings, GTM tags, Snowflake guidance, A/A test

## Action Items
**Logan Bates**  
Verify Witold access to AI features (01:04)  
Send video guide and documentation to Witold (04:07)  

**Rémy Marin**  
Upgrade Witold organization to enterprise tier (01:25)  
Advise Witold on removing duplicate GTM tags (02:49)  

**Witold Styczen**  
Prepare tests for visual editor (02:26)  
Contact support team for Snowflake guidance (02:40)  
Temporarily disable custom HTML Growbook script (03:40)
